updates.closure_rationale: A portable C17 bounded selector chooses actual typed1..4 wrappers with a nonempty helper tail; explicit0 forms append an empty record. Exact separate counters include sink and fields, even when a full sink refuses. Actual original numeric dispatch is separately exercised through modulo wrap and zero identity; no function-argument order guarantee is invented. Actual preprocessing output identifies all four selected functions. Six negative translation specimens per compiler distinguish raw integer/wrong structure, omitted/empty argument, five-field arity and unprotected compound-literal comma. C17 rejects the separate VA_OPT probe; GCC/Clang C2x and C++20 execute its empty/nonempty behavior. N1570 clauses and N3033 proposal passages were actually read, with published C17/C23 gaps retained. Legal numeric conversion and Clang warning-as-error policy have separate executed positive/negative evidence. Six compiler profiles pass4anchors and8compiled ordinary semantic controls, including actual retained numeric defects;4compiling learner stubs reject. Every profile matches5248 independently modeled record cases:468successes,3201invalid,684full and895range refusals. Exact copied binary/filename/line, caller storage changes, null+zero, maximum extents and whole-sink refusal snapshots are checked. Seven equal-record timing samples and actual stack/helpers/object/preprocessing/build observations are retained; no diagnostic failure is misreported as a runtime assertion. Required logging transfer is implemented as a four-record sink with0..4 typed number/binary fields, optional copied source metadata and explicit refusal precedence. All borrowed inputs end at return; no heap, I/O or concurrent-safety premise is hidden. Already evaluated caller effects remain on refusal while sink bytes remain unchanged. Metadata-present/absent, binary input mutation, filename255/256 and full/invalid calls support the delayed variant. All13cost/enforcement dimensions are explicit. No independent delayed learner or human result is inferred. Bounded author support only.
